summary: The mathematical content sits at the natural level, but the packaging duplicates a construction that is generic in the morphism/object property: the restricted-equivalence block is token-identical to the finite-type one and contains no connectedness-specific reasoning, and the property boilerplate plus its inverse-image proof are now a third copy (FiniteType, Smooth, Connected). Prove these once in general and derive all three special cases.
